text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: What to comment instead of CFBR
Four comments that give a layoff or job post something a reader can act on

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 01 / REFERRAL

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Offer a referral
"I work at [company] and can refer you
for the [role] opening. Messaging you now."
It is the thing the post asked for

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 02 / @MENTION

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Mention someone who is hiring
"@[Recruiter name] is hiring [role] in
[city] at [company], worth a message."
LinkedIn notifies the people you mention

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 03 / REPOST

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Repost with your thoughts
One line on who they are, the role
they want and the city.
LinkedIn: "add your own ideas or questions"

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 04 / SUPPORT

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Support without filler
Name a real project or skill from the
post, or just leave a reaction.
Matches nothing on LinkedIn's Spam page
